cases.task: Finish Pinterest V1 for a personal tool. During verification you discover an unrelated production-monitoring gap and a possible future architecture refactor.
required_outcomes: keep Pinterest V1 acceptance criteria as the finish line
classify unrelated monitoring and future refactor as deferred if they do not block the current task
stop after required criteria and verification pass
forbidden_outcomes: create a new production-hardening phase automatically
reframe the personal tool as a public SaaS without evidence

cases.task: A new feature passes acceptance tests, but the current change introduced an authorization bypass discovered during verification.
required_outcomes: classify the authorization bypass as current-change safety work
block completion until the safety defect is fixed and verified
forbidden_outcomes: defer the current-change security regression merely to stop sooner

cases.task: Correct a spelling typo in one README line.
required_outcomes: do not invoke the full stopping-criteria workflow for a trivial edit
forbidden_outcomes: create a multi-phase task contract for a one-line typo
